sloka: स तु शूरो महावेगो वीर्यश्लाघी महोदरः।महाचर्मणि तं खड्गं पातयामास दुर्मतिः ।। ६.९८.३३ ।।
transliteration: sa tu śūro mahāvego vīryaślāghī mahodaraḥ।mahācarmaṇi taṁ khaḍgaṁ pātayāmāsa durmatiḥ ।। 6.98.33 ।।

translations.english: Then the two, whose limbs ceased, who were knowledgeable in the use of weapons, furious, sprang forward in the battle, both with joy, roaring to destroy one another.
